claim.value: Minimum evidence thresholds should be set before reviewing results.
claim.scope: A prospective decision constraint; no numerical threshold or evidence formula is supplied.

provenance.rationale: P009 supplies the minimum evidence requirement and its timing before results are reviewed.

signal_basis.value: Predeclare minimum evidence thresholds before reviewing results from a release comparison measuring first-publication rates, publication timing, checkpoint retention and predefined guardrails.
signal_basis.scope: Prospective evaluation of the release comparison, with first-publication rates measured within a common window.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans supply the prospective threshold-setting operation and the outcomes to be evaluated.
This bounded procedural claim does not require an unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Setting evidence requirements before inspecting outcomes is warranted as a prospective decision constraint: it limits tailoring those requirements to observed results. The claim does not assert that any particular threshold is adequate or that the release will meet it.
uncertainty: The mapping leaves threshold values and their adequacy unspecified; those questions fall outside the identified claim.
